messages:
Nora (CSM): Quick note 0% discount on months 1-3 requested by MeridianHealth as a ramp incentive. They prefer a wire for the deposit and will send a PO afterward. Can finance/legal confirm acceptable fallback?
Ben (Finance Ops): Wire for deposit ok. We require invoice entity, deposit %, and whether the discount is bound to usage milestones. Also prefer PO on file within 30 days.
Ravi (Customer Procurement): We'll send PO after internal approval. Deposit via wire OK. Invoice entity is 'MeridianHealth Solutions LLC'.
Claire (Legal): If discount is conditional on milestones, need explicit milestone language in amendment. If it's unconditional for months 1-3, simpler pricing addendum works. Who signs on their side?
Nora (CSM): Contact is procurement lead Ravi (here) and their Ops Director can sign (confirmed). Discount is unconditional for the first 3 months.
docusign-bot: Draft pricing addendum uploaded: https://redwood.internal/agreements/meridian-pricing-addendum-v1.pdf
Ben (Finance Ops): We'll take 25% deposit via wire. Tom from revenue ops will DM bank details. Add fallback: provisionally enable service on CC if wire/PO delayed >5 business days.
Claire (Legal): I'll prepare a 1-page addendum reflecting 3-month discount, 25% deposit, and delegated signer clause. Will mark expedite.
Nora (CSM): Thanks. Action: Claire to draft, Ben to send wire DM, Ravi to route PO and delegated signer name. I'll coordinate DocuSign once draft is final. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Customer Procurement): Will aim to have PO in 7-10 business days. Will confirm signer name today.
